Karma Common API

Internal

Server
Download schema

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/health

Simple health check endpoint. Returns basic status of database and Redis dependencies. Used for quick health verification.

Responses

Service is healthy

status
​string · enum · required

Overall service status

Enum values:
healthy
unhealthy
​object · required
timestamp
​string · date-time · required

Check timestamp

GET/health
curl --request GET \ --url https://common-api.karma.life/health
Example Responses
{ "status": "healthy", "checks": { "database": true, "redis": true }, "timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:30:00.000Z" }
json
application/json

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/live

Kubernetes liveness probe. Lightweight check that the service process is running. Does not check external dependencies. Use to determine if the service should be restarted.

Responses

200

Service is alive

status
​string · enum · required

Process status

Enum values:
alive
timestamp
​string · date-time · required

Check timestamp

uptime
​number · required

Service uptime in seconds

GET/live
curl --request GET \ --url https://common-api.karma.life/live
Example Responses
{ "status": "alive", "timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:30:00.000Z", "uptime": 3600 }
json
application/json

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/ready

Kubernetes readiness probe with detailed dependency status. Returns response times and error details for each dependency. Use for determining if the service is ready to receive traffic.

Responses

Service is ready to receive traffic

status
​string · enum · required

Overall status

Enum values:
healthy
degraded
unhealthy
timestamp
​string · date-time · required

Check timestamp

uptime
​number · required

Service uptime in seconds

​object · required
GET/ready
curl --request GET \ --url https://common-api.karma.life/ready
Example Responses
{ "status": "healthy", "timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:30:00.000Z", "uptime": 3600, "dependencies": { "database": { "status": "healthy", "responseTimeMs": 5 }, "redis": { "status": "healthy", "responseTimeMs": 2 } } }
json
application/json
